# uiFileDnD

- Upstream: https://github.com/xiangruili/uiFileDnD
- Source file: `uiFileDnD.m`
- Upstream revision date noted in the source: 2026-03-05
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

The vendored function is kept inside `FREQNESS_GUI` so the GUI remains
self-contained. Its R2025a startup guidance was adapted to point to the GUI
launcher, which creates the required root property before constructing the
application window.
